_doc: Golden for contract-f2 (mission saoc-inner-heroes, F2: HM-5, HM-7, HM-8, /members note, the /events/[slug] candidate sheet; NOS Design 2026-10-27 rulings folded in). Source: NOS Design 2026-10-26 '#116 (9b8a1e63) beta pass' (comms.md). Extends goldens/crop-map.json (f1); the f2 gates read both through checks/f2-lib.mjs.

hm5.ruling: HM-5: keep the same end, ease the ramp: 0 @34%, .06 @38%, .16 @42%, .32 @45%, .52 @48%, .70 @50.5%, .80 @52%. Sage rgb(34 40 31) only. Below 768 the scrim stays display:none.

focalAlpha.zone: left 0-39% of the hero: where the ruled stops stay at or under .1 (.085 at 39%). NOS Design named the focal centre 'lip/column' without coordinates; 39% is this contract's reading and is an open question (spec-f2.md).

hm8.ruling: The typographic band sizes to its content at >= 1024: padding-block clamp(64px, 6vw, 96px), no min-height. Gate: band height <= content + 192 at 1440 and 2056. < 768 unchanged. LG-RF stays green.

eventFacts.ruling: HM-7 (NOS Design 2026-10-27): left-align BOTH dt and dd to the h1 edge. Gate dt.left = dd.left = h1.left +-1 at 1440 and 2056. The hero keeps its current photograph for now.

sheets.note: The /events/[slug] cut is NOT implemented in f2: the deliverable is one candidate sheet for NOS Design's pick (in-situ sheet at 1440@2 with scrim, h1, chip, and a 1:1 crop of the left 44%). HM-6 is no longer a sheet deliverable: NOS Design 2026-10-27 ruled /societies/[slug] typographic (b), implemented in f2.

candidates.ruling: HM-7: one cut distinct from home's dark and /sponsors' dark-flip. Pink and yellow stay retired.

draftNotice.ruling: P3 + NOS Design 2026-10-27 (open question 2): the draft notice is 15px with a 1px rule below, on /refunds as well as /members, through ONE shared component (components/ui/DraftNotice.tsx). Plain p, bold lead-in, border 0 on three sides, 1px solid rule below, transparent, no wrapper box, text verbatim.
draftNotice.source: comms.md 10-25 LG-RF item 3: 'sans 15px, muted ink, the bold lead-in kept, and a 1px rule below it. No border, no fill, no box.'; NOS Design 2026-10-27.
